title: AI usage
description: See how much of your Claude and Codex limits is left this session and this week, how your pace compares, and when each resets, in the menu bar.
examples: Glance at the menu bar: ✳ Claude's and ⊛ Codex's session left, amber once a window is 60% used, red from 85%

Click it: a card per provider and Codex account with its email and plan, each window's share left, its pace mark and line (in reserve or deficit, lasts until reset or runs out when) and its reset, Claude's per-model week and Codex's limit reset credits

preferences.name: codexHomes
preferences.title: Codex accounts
preferences.description: Codex folders (CODEX_HOME) asked through Codex's own app-server, comma separated; Codex signs in with its own login. Any other ~/.codex-* folder is listed from its session logs only, never asked.

preferences.name: codexBar
preferences.title: Ask CodexBar's Codex accounts
preferences.description: Also ask Codex for each account added in CodexBar, the same way: Pilot reads only each account's email and folder from CodexBar's account list, and Codex signs in with that folder's login. An account already shown above is shown once.

preferences.name: show
preferences.title: Show usage as
preferences.description: The share of each limit the bar, meters and summary show: what is left, as CodexBar shows it, or what is used.

preferences.name: barProviders
preferences.title: Menu bar shows
preferences.description: Which providers' figures the menu bar item shows. A click still shows every provider.

preferences.name: barWindow
preferences.title: Menu bar figure
preferences.description: The window behind each provider's figure: its session, as CodexBar shows it, or whichever window is the most used.

preferences.name: pace
preferences.title: Show pace
preferences.description: Each meter's mark where its usage should be by now, and its line: in reserve or in deficit, lasts until the reset or runs out when.

preferences.name: otherCodex
preferences.title: List other Codex folders
preferences.description: Also list ~/.codex-* folders not in Codex accounts, from their logs only.

preferences.name: gemini
preferences.title: Show Gemini
preferences.description: Gemini's card, which says only whether its CLI is set up: Gemini keeps no limit on this Mac.

commands.name: bar
commands.title: AI usage in the menu bar
